body:
## About the modpack ##

This modpack can be used to revive the experience of discovering the world of Minecraft. The mods where selected to recreate all the fellings and almost all aspects of the great cubic game. With mods to add new mobs, new ways to generate your world, advanced machinery, combat system and lots of optimization.

Some of the best mods in the modpack:
- Terralith
- Alex's mobs
- Create (and lots of addons)
- Essential mod

Besides those, we have texture packs to rework the game's textures, new animations, and other things.
 
### Features ###

Essential features for the game:
- Machinery
- Trims
- Animations
- Villager readjustments
- Purpur pack's vannila friendly additions
- Ships, Cars, Planes and other machines you can build with clockwork
- New sound physics
